title: 星絨法師：自走遠征

roster.bossCadence: Final encounter of every third depth:3,6,9...; regional pair alternates.
roster.entryRule: All normal and boss future arrivals use three adjacent NE lanes, not three directions; .55 seconds apart.

behavior: All future normal/boss arrivals come from the visible-cued NE entrance fan; existing live actors are not teleported or deleted.
Nearby actors retain readable spacing, remain in the NE quadrant and cannot block the SW exit.
Travel, full-health preparation and post-loot empty waits are shortened; health recovery, damage, skills and attack telegraphs keep their existing rules.
All50 monsters,10 bosses, original art, bestiary, backpack and whole-build comparison remain unchanged.
limits: Combat power is a comparative build index, not guaranteed victory or exact DPS.
Five regions cycle; finite five-skill tree at rank10 each.
No offline gains or automatic allocation/equipping; browser memory/storage quotas still apply.
Import safety limit32MiB; level999 and depth9999 maximum.
Native Canvas and VM tests are not browser/mobile performance or human-play certification.

pacingSummary.method: Same-seed accelerated fresh-start create/tick/ordinary-act scenarios; not actual browser timing.
pacingSummary.caveat: A few unspent-build resupply tails are longer because encounters are denser; healing is preserved rather than skipped.
